bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 171, Number 163 (Friday, October 3, 2025)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. McGOVERN:
H.R. 5684.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clause 1, the Spending Clause, and
Article 1, Section 8, Clause 18, the Necessary and Proper
Clause.
[Page H4517]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on Ways and Means, and Oversight and Government Reform, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
